Prima & Timo — (6) Timo (Ver. 6.0) Nonaginta Octo

Up Where I Belong

"I'll do what I must, I'll find the truth"

Let’s go”

[Verse 1]

We headed back upward, Kai and Toes beside me now

The cave felt different, like we were leaving something sacred down

Kai navigated steadily, voice calm with old-sea charm

Toes kept offering toast, “Best fuel for the team heading to land!”

We passed by the ancients and their village, the machines gathered at the gate

Wheel rolled forward slowly, voice heavy with the weight

“Be careful up there… things are changing fast, we feel

Something or someone… is forcing the - wheel”

Yes, Pun intended.

[Pre-Chorus]

I nodded, heart heavy but resolve strong

“I’ll be back as soon as I finish where I belong”

[Chorus]

Up Where I Belong

I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth

Up Where I Belong

So I can return to you

The world above is calling, but my heart stays down below

I’ll finish what I started… then back to you I go

[Verse 2]

We reached the sea at last, waves crashing on the shore

Kai checked the map, “X marks the spot, not far from this shore”

A place that seems distant but somehow feels like home

Toes burned fresh toast, “For the journey, Kai, go ahead take one!”

Kai laughed, “You and your honorable toast — always ready for war”

Toes replied proudly, “Best fuel, nothing more!”

Kai said - come inside and welcome aboard!

Ready for whatever waited… on this new road

[Pre-Chorus 2]

I looked back one last time toward the cave below

Whispered softly, “I’ll see you soon… I promise, I know”

[Chorus]

Up Where I Belong

I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth

Up Where I Belong

So I can return to you

The world above is calling, but my heart stays down below

I’ll finish what I started… then back to you I go

[Bridge — hopeful]

Kai said “We will get you there, honorable friend.”

Toes said “And I will toast along the way, till the very end!”

[Acoustic solo]

[Coda]

Heading to a place I do not know

But we have no choice we have to go

Someday all this will makes sense

Someday all this will make us understand

Maybe I will even find out who I am

And why I am this way and where I came from

[Pre-Chorus 2]

I think about here one last time as I close my eyes-

Alright crew - no turning back - Let’s go -

[Chorus]

Up Where I Belong

I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth

Up Where I Belong

So I can return to you

The world above is calling, but my heart stays down below

I’ll finish what I started… then back to you I go

[Outro — determined]

The sea stretched endless…

But my purpose was clear.

I’ll be back soon

Be safe till then.
